svg.title: IEC 104: a 6-byte APCI, then the ASDU
svg.desc: The APDU of frame 9 of wireshark_iec104.pcap, 32 bits per row: the APCI with its start byte 0x68, length 14 and four control bytes announcing an I-format frame with send and receive sequence numbers 0, then the ASDU: type 100 (C_IC_NA_1), SQ 0 with one object, cause of transmission 6 (activation), originator 0, common address 10, the information object address 0 and the qualifier of interrogation 20; Iec104Packet keeps one Apdu with its format and its decoded Asdu.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
